notes.title: 🦑👁️ JAPANESE LOCALIZATION UPDATE 1.999! 👁️🦑
notes.notes:
Dear Japanese-speaking followers, we extend our deepest gratitude for being part of our haunting journey! As we continue to explore the mysteries that lurk in the shadows, we invite you to plunge deeper into the abyss with the latest update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2546710/MY_DAUGHTER_IS_A_CULTIST_SE/]MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/1985ad2e0b6e70cfdf25a74a6729dd2a8a98cedb.png[/img]

🎌 EXPLORE THE UNSEEN IN YOUR NATIVE TONGUE!

Immerse yourself in the dark and mysterious world of our horror game, now fully localized in Japanese. From menus to dialogue and even the intricate lore, experience the terror and beauty of "MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE" like never before.

🔍 DISCOVER ALL 4 ENDINGS, UNRAVEL THE LORE!

Embark on a journey to unveil the secrets hidden within the game's narrative. Seek out all four endings, collect journal pages scattered throughout the eerie house, and capture chillingly cute moments in this refined version of the game.

🐞 BUG FIXES - A SMOOTHER NIGHTMARE AWAITS!

In our relentless pursuit of perfection, we've exorcised a lurking bug to ensure a smoother, more immersive experience. Your journey through the unknown is now free from eldritch interruptions.

🌐 MORE LANGUAGES ON THE HORIZON!

As we embrace the global community of horror enthusiasts, be on the lookout for additional language support in the coming year. The cultists know no bounds, and we're committed to bringing it to you in languages that resonate with terror.

👻 UPDATE NOW AND FACE THE UNSEEN IN JAPANESE!

Download the latest update for "MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE" on Steam and dive into the abyss with newfound terror in your native language. Unravel the mysteries, face the terrors, and remember - Cthulhu will rise again. 👁️🦑

notes.title: Update 1.666
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/e5b1477d5f0291acab7f0bda550a529a878ce437.png[/img]

We have just launched our first update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2546710/MY_DAUGHTER_IS_A_CULTIST_SE/]MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE [/url]with a few minor bug fixes and improvements to gameplay.

UPDATE NOTES: 
[list]
[*] Frame rate cap button added to options menu
[*] Escape key for options as default
[*] New warning screen to warn players  (and  set the mood)
[*] Decreased door interaction area
[*] Changed textures of the books and note pages to look better on lower resolutions
[*] Remade manga and night text graphics to be less pixelated
[*] TV static will always be the same volume and not randomized
[*] Fixed swinging doors so they can't trap players
[*] Disabled photomode diorama until it is visible
[*] Now screenshots are automatically added to your Steam library
[*] Made all doors and walls opaque 
[*] Opening books and acquiring letters now trigger sounds to make the 3D sounds that stop during pauses less abrupt 
[*] Changed text in the diorama to clarify options
[*] Tweaked drawer, lamp and note interaction ranges
[*] Added a button to the lamp to show where you should interact with it
[*] Added new logo to the photomode
[*] Tweaked photomode filters and frames
[*] Fixed UI elements in different resolutions
[/list]

Please stay tuned for the next update coming out in December that will feature a Japanese translation.

Thank you for your continued support,

Virtua Worlds

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/9509d42181d0fe2a312f907fba2abe16961edbfa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/ba48ccc0f81981be85a0bdd5cc1717228c6d1c4a.png[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/302c43d84225ef69f98f184fc595074c07135a10.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/a51cd96640dc923e61eac1a71978dd3692c013ec.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/15b23665d4efdd15b2b1c55b5c780b25dda42c90.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/8b4e2abe521012c4d8c7c204186849ccd8224aad.png[/img][/url]

[h3][url=https://news.gamebase.com.tw/news/detail/99416379]GAMEBASE. COM
[/url][/h3]

[i]The game brings out a scary atmosphere with strong black and white graphics. As players explore and interact with items in their home every night, the truth about their daughter's strange behavior will gradually be revealed. [/i]

notes.title: MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/757bb45b5c1fd1f5d69656c575904fb0be5ab31a.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2546710/MY_DAUGHTER_IS_A_CULTIST_SE/]MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE [/url]is a short and surreal black and white experience that blends Japanese and LoVecraftian cosmic horror.

You are a widowed dad trying to get some sleep, awakened by a bump in the night. What was that? Why is your daughter acting so weird? Is it parenthood or a horrible curiosity that compels you to find out?

Previously released as a game jam demo, MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE is now a fully flesHed out experience available on Steam and Itch.io! Your ancestral home is now furnished, you discover letters from your late wife, and you've taken up photography.

This short interactive fiction offers four different endings to unlock, the ability to create your own photo scenes with various settings, outfits, and poses, plus brand new spooky gameplay events that will challenge your sanity.

Thank you for playing and have a happy Halloween!

Virtua World5
